synthesizedFacts.fact: Sunscreen should generally be applied after moisturizer as the last step in a skincare routine.
Chemical sunscreens should be applied before moisturizer to ensure proper absorption.
Mineral sunscreens should be applied after moisturizer as they act as a physical barrier.
Using a moisturizer with SPF can simplify the skincare routine.
